bug_report:
Modules ICE using decltype and lambda across TUs
This may be doing something ill-advised, I believe there are some potential issues with lambda type linkage, but anyway it obviously shouldn't be crashing the compiler.

Minimal repro:

// m-part.mxx
export module m:part;

namespace kdeps
{
    export template < typename F >
    auto fun1(F)
    {
        return true;
    }

    using Dodgy = decltype([] {});

    export template < typename T >
    auto fun2(T&&)
    {
        return fun1(Dodgy{});
    }
}

// m.mxx
export module m;

export import :part;
